hero.title: A Corniche Show Residence, Open to Remote Buyers
hero.body: Remote buyers tour the built show residence at Erth Real Estate Development's Raffles Residences on the Jeddah Corniche in interactive 3D, before they reserve off-plan.

sidebar: Erth Real Estate Development · Brand partner: Raffles Hotels & Resorts
Raffles Residences Jeddah · branded luxury residences and penthouses, 48 floors
3D show residence tour · WebGL twin · Sales team training

challenge.title: Letting Remote Buyers Inspect a Luxury Residence
challenge.body: Luxury buyers want to see finishes, ceiling heights and sea views before they commit to an off-plan branded tower. Erth had built a show residence, but buyers in Riyadh and across the GCC couldn't easily visit Jeddah.
rows: Out-of-region VIP buyers delay reserving until they can travel to the show residence.
True-scale 3D tour: the built show residence captured with true materials and lighting.
Floor plans can't convey deep terraces and panoramic Red Sea views.
Interactive view simulation: floor-specific sea views and sunset angles.
Separate PDFs and renders dilute the Raffles brand.
One branded web experience: curated 3D walkthroughs that open on any tablet or browser without an app.

solution.title: An Interactive 3D Tour with Corniche Views
solution.body: Manzili scanned the built show residence and turned its geometry and materials into a fast WebGL walkthrough, linked from showroom touch displays to remote buyers' devices.

blocks.title: True-Scale Show Residence Twin
points: 1:1 capture of master suites, living rooms and designer kitchens.
Accurate timber paneling, imported marble and custom joinery.

blocks.title: Corniche View Synthesis
points: Drone panoramas aligned with each window opening.
Accurate Red Sea horizons at different tower heights.

blocks.title: Private VIP Links
points: Advisors create secure, unit-specific links for private investor walkthroughs.
Works on desktops, iPads and phones with no download.

blocks.title: Showroom Display Sync
points: High-definition touch consoles in Erth's private sales lounges.
Advisors guide clients through rooms, wardrobes and terraces.

enablement.title: Polished Presentations for Global Luxury Buyers
enablement.body: Manzili trained Erth's private client advisors to use the digital twin in VIP consultations, focusing on hospitality amenities, services and craftsmanship.

steps.title: Waterfront Positioning
steps.body: Advisors open on the Corniche exterior, showing marinas, beach clubs and downtown access.

steps.title: Floor & Layout Selection
steps.body: The advisor selects the floor and checks orientation, privacy and Red Sea views.

steps.title: Interior Walkthrough
steps.body: The client enters the 3D show residence and inspects proportions, ceiling heights and finishes room by room.

rows: True marble veining, metal trims and glass reflections
Private viewing links protected by time-limited tokens and access control
Consistent 60 FPS on smartphones, tablets and 4K displays
